n3360c87cf6e.s: The National Institute of Disaster Management (NIDM) Southern Campus promised to Andhra Pradesh under the Thirteenth Schedule is at:
n3360c87cf6e.x: The NIDM was promised for Andhra Pradesh, with its Southern Campus at Kondapalli near Vijayawada.

nf76042c0aa7.s: IIT Tirupati and IISER Tirupati are both located at:
nf76042c0aa7.x: Both IIT Tirupati and IISER Tirupati are at Yerpedu; Gambheeram is the site of IIM Visakhapatnam.

n5c71b8278c9.s: Which of the following pairs (institution – ministry) is correctly matched?
o: NIDM Southern Campus, Kondapalli – Ministry of Education
IIITDM Kurnool – Ministry of Home Affairs
NIDM Southern Campus, Kondapalli – Ministry of Electronics and IT
n5c71b8278c9.x: IIITDM Kurnool is an Institution of National Importance under the Ministry of Education; the NIDM Southern Campus at Kondapalli is under the Ministry of Home Affairs.

nb55abadc8cb.s: The Thirteenth Schedule promised Andhra Pradesh an IIT, NIT, IIM and IISER, but no:
nb55abadc8cb.x: The list included an IIT, NIT, IIM, IISER, IIIT and several universities, but no National Institute of Fashion Technology.

nd12d771687f.s: The Rambilli and Nakkapalli clusters, accounting for about 49% of VCIC output, belong to which node?
nd12d771687f.x: Rambilli and Nakkapalli are clusters of the Visakhapatnam node, which accounts for about 49% of the corridor's output.

n8bb6e4ff90b.s: Special Category Status in India is:
o: A category expressly provided in the Constitution
A category created by a constitutional amendment
A classification listed in the Seventh Schedule
n8bb6e4ff90b.x: SCS is not a constitutional category; it arose as an executive, Planning Commission-era classification linked to preferential Plan assistance.

n7e5f4326fd0.s: Andhra Pradesh argued that the Fourteenth Finance Commission's uniform 42 per cent devolution ignored its asymmetric loss of:
n7e5f4326fd0.x: The 42 per cent devolution applied to all States alike, so it did not compensate AP for losing Hyderabad.

nd5643976e2f.s: Which of the following States has never been granted Special Category Status?
nd5643976e2f.x: Telangana has never been granted SCS; Mizoram, Arunachal Pradesh and Tripura are among the 11 SCS States.

nadd68cba48b.s: Which of the following pairs about the 2014 assurance of Special Category Status to Andhra Pradesh is correctly matched?
o: Given by – Prime Minister Manmohan Singh
nadd68cba48b.x: PM Manmohan Singh gave the assurance on 20 February 2014 in the Rajya Sabha, promising SCS for five years.

new.s: Which Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure commitment uses the binding words 'shall develop'?
o: Integrated steel plant in YSR district
Greenfield refinery in the Kakinada region
new.x: Only the major port at Duggirajupatnam carries 'shall develop'; the steel plant, refinery and VCIC were only to be examined.

new.s: The South Coast Railway zone, examined under the Thirteenth Schedule, became operational on:
new.x: SCoR, headquartered at Visakhapatnam, became operational on 1 June 2026.

new.s: The Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh is located in which district?
new.x: The Tribal University was first proposed near Visakhapatnam but moved to Vizianagaram (Dattirajeru mandal).

new.s: The Central University and the Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh were established under:
new.x: Both were set up under the Central Universities (Amendment) Act, 2019; the 2009 Act is only the parent Act.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (institution – legal basis) is correctly matched?
new.x: AIIMS Mangalagiri was set up under PMSSY; NIT and IISER come under the NITSER Act and IIPE under the IIPE Act, 2017.

new.s: NIT Andhra Pradesh is located at:
new.x: NIT Andhra Pradesh is at Tadepalligudem in West Godavari.

new.s: SAIL's feasibility report of 2 December 2014 on the Kadapa steel plant found it:
o: Viable only with an EAF route
new.x: SAIL's report found the plant prima facie not financially viable; a Task Force followed in 2016.

new.s: The State SPV formed in November 2019 for a 3 MTPA steel plant in Kadapa is:
new.x: Andhra Pradesh formed its own SPV, AP High Grade Steels Ltd, in November 2019 for a 3 MTPA plant.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the JSW Rayalaseema Integrated Steel Plant:
1. It will cost Rs 16,350 crore in two phases.
2. It is a scrap-based Electric Arc Furnace green steel plant.
3. It was named in the AP Reorganisation Act as a SAIL plant.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The JSW plant costs Rs 16,350 crore and uses a scrap-based EAF; the Act named SAIL only to examine a plant, while the actual plant is private JSW.

new.s: The SPV for the revived Dugarajapatnam port and shipbuilding cluster is a 50:50 joint venture of:
new.x: National Shipbuilding and Heavy Industries Park Andhra Pradesh Ltd (2 Mar 2026) is a 50:50 JV of Visakhapatnam Port Authority and AP Maritime Board.

new.s: Dugarajapatnam was dropped as a major port partly because of risk to which lake?
new.x: The 2016 AECOM study found it not viable, with risk to Pulicat Lake and to the security of Sriharikota.

new.s: Phase-I of Ramayapatnam Port provides for a capacity of:
new.x: Ramayapatnam Phase-I costs Rs 4,929.39 crore, with 4 berths and 34.04 MTPA capacity.

new.s: Ramayapatnam Port lies about 93 km north of which port?
new.x: Ramayapatnam is 93 km north of Krishnapatnam and 5 km east of Thettu on NH-16.

new.s: Among Andhra Pradesh's four greenfield ports, which recorded the highest progress (74.34%) in October 2025?
new.x: Ramayapatnam, at 74.34% in October 2025, had the highest progress of the four greenfield ports.

new.s: For the GAIL-HPCL Kakinada petrochemical complex, the Centre asked Andhra Pradesh to pay viability gap funding of:
new.x: The Centre said Rs 5,615 crore of viability gap funding was needed for the ~Rs 32,901 crore complex; AP refused to pay.

new.s: The proposed BPCL refinery-cum-petrochemical complex near Ramayapatnam has a capacity of:
new.x: The BPCL complex is a 9 MTPA refinery costing about Rs 1.45 lakh crore.

new.s: The proposed Visakhapatnam metro rail project has:
new.x: The Visakhapatnam metro plan has 4 corridors covering 76.70 km at Rs 11,498 crore.

new.s: As per the January 2026 Governor's address, the Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada metro projects had been approved by:
new.x: The Governor's address said both metros were approved by the State; the Vizag metro is still before the Centre.

new.s: On 20 May 2026, who said Reorganisation Act promises worth about Rs 5 lakh crore remained unfulfilled?
new.x: Y.S. Sharmila said promises like Kadapa steel, Dugarajapatnam and metro rail, worth about Rs 5 lakh crore, were unfulfilled.

new.s: The proposed southern AP industrial cluster links the Kadapa steel plant and the BPCL refinery with which port?
new.x: Kadapa steel, Ramayapatnam port and the BPCL refinery, linked by a new rail line, form the southern AP industrial cluster.

new.s: For the rail and road link from the new AP capital to Hyderabad, the Thirteenth Schedule requires the Government of India to:
new.x: The Act only asks GoI to 'take steps' for rapid rail and road connectivity to Hyderabad, with no deadline; VCIC was to be examined within six months.

new.s: Orvakal is a node of which industrial corridor?
new.x: Orvakal belongs to the Hyderabad-Bengaluru Industrial Corridor, not to the VCIC.

new.s: The Vizag-Chennai Industrial Corridor is approximately how long?
new.x: The VCIC is about 800 km long and forms the first phase of the ECEC.

new.s: Tranche-I and the Policy-Based Loan for the VCIC were signed on:
new.x: Tranche-I and the Policy-Based Loan were signed on 23 February 2017 by DEA, ADB and GoAP.

new.s: The Government of Andhra Pradesh's share in the $840 million VCIC programme is:
new.x: GoAP contributes $215 million (25.6%) and ADB $625 million (74.4%) of the $840 million.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a project implementation unit of the VCIC in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: The PIUs are APIIC, APRDC, AP Transco and GVMC; NICDC is a national corporation, not a VCIC PIU.

new.s: Phase-1 of the Kopparthy node in YSR Kadapa covers:
new.x: Kopparthy Phase-1 is 2,596 acres; 2,002 acres is the Bulk Drug Park and 2,628 acres the Chittoor start-up area.

new.s: The 2,002-acre Bulk Drug Park is part of which VCIC node?
new.x: The Visakhapatnam node has the 2,002-acre Bulk Drug Park.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about industrial corridor bodies:
1. NICDC is a corporation, formerly DMICDC.
2. NICDIT is a trust.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: NICDC is a corporation (ex-DMICDC, January 2008) and NICDIT is a trust that funds node trunk infrastructure.

new.s: The National Industrial Corridor Development Corporation functions under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry through:
new.x: NICDC works under Commerce & Industry via DPIIT and runs NICDP and BHAVYA.

new.s: The BHAVYA scheme (2026-27 to 2031-32) has an outlay of:
new.x: BHAVYA has an outlay of Rs 33,660 crore for 100 parks, six of them in AP.

new.s: The Mega Food Park in Andhra Pradesh is at:
new.x: The Mega Food Park is at Mallavalli in Krishna district.

new.s: Electronics Manufacturing Cluster-1 (EMC-1) in Andhra Pradesh is at:
new.x: EMC-1 is at Renigunta (Tirupati); the YSR EMC at Kopparthy is EMC-2.

new.s: Under APSEZ incentives, stamp duty exemption is:
new.x: APSEZ incentives include 100% stamp duty exemption and a 3% interest subsidy.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT an APIIC cluster location?
new.x: APIIC clusters are at Gandrajupalle, Kopparthi, Makavarapalem and Machilipatnam; Parawada hosts Jawaharlal Nehru Pharma City.

new.s: The six-lane NH-716B expressway in Andhra Pradesh runs from Chittoor to:
new.x: The ~116 km Chittoor-Thatchur expressway (NH-716B) ends at Thatchur near Ennore in Tamil Nadu.

new.s: Which access-controlled greenfield expressway in Andhra Pradesh has been approved by MoRTH?
new.x: The Anantapur-Amaravati expressway is an access-controlled greenfield road approved by MoRTH; Nagpur-Vijayawada and Kharagpur-Visakhapatnam-Amaravati were fast-tracked in January 2026.

new.s: The Bengaluru-Chennai Expressway was taken up under:
new.x: The Bengaluru-Chennai Expressway is a Bharatmala Phase-I project and a priority link of CBIC.

new.s: Multimodal logistics parks (MMLPs) in Andhra Pradesh have been identified at Visakhapatnam and:
new.x: MMLPs are identified at Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada.

new.s: Budget 2026 announced which port corridor in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Budget 2026 named the Visakhapatnam-Kakinada port corridor.

new.s: The Gadgil Formula for distributing Plan funds was approved by:
new.x: The NDC approved the Gadgil Formula; the 5th Finance Commission recommended SCS - the two are often swapped.

new.s: Which of the following was a criterion for Special Category Status?
new.x: Strategic location along international borders is a criterion; high population density and advanced infrastructure are not.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Special Category Status criteria:
1. Non-viable state finances was a criterion.
2. Low population density and/or sizeable tribal population was a criterion.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are among the five SCS criteria, along with hilly terrain, strategic borders and backwardness.

new.s: Consumer Welfare Fund seed money is shared between Centre and a Special Category State in the ratio:
new.x: For SCS States the Consumer Welfare Fund ratio is 90:10, against 75:25 for general States.

new.s: Which was the last of the 11 States to get Special Category Status?
new.x: Uttarakhand was the last of the 11 SCS States.

new.s: The Centre feared that SCS for Andhra Pradesh would bring identical demands from:
new.x: Bihar and Odisha had also asked for SCS and were never granted it.

new.s: The Fourteenth Finance Commission's recommendations, the largest devolution increase ever, were accepted on:
new.x: The 14th FC award (32% to 42%) was accepted on 24 February 2015.

new.s: What share of the divisible pool did the Fifteenth Finance Commission give to States?
new.x: The 15th FC (N.K. Singh) set the States' share at 41%; 42% was the 14th FC.

new.s: The no-confidence motion of July 2018 linked to Andhra Pradesh's SCS demand was moved in:
new.x: After the TDP left the NDA in 2018, a no-confidence motion was moved in the Lok Sabha and defeated; the 2014 assurance was in the Rajya Sabha.

new.s: In 2019, which party called the Special Assistance Package for Andhra Pradesh a 'betrayal'?
new.x: In 2019 YSRCP called the Special Assistance Package a 'betrayal'.
